Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to onboard Acme Robotics but finance needs a completed tax form to validate the TIN before we can issue the PO. Please provide one of the following, signed and returned: a completed IRS W-9 (if US entity) or a W-8BEN-E (if foreign entity), plus either the IRS SS-4 confirmation letter or a bank letter that shows the EIN/TIN.

We're holding PO #4578 in the queue until we can verify the tax identity — can you get the docs to us by end of day Thursday (2026-12-03)? If you expect a delay, let us know so we can coordinate timelines.

Attachments: supplier-onboarding-form.pdf (fillable)

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Lauren — thanks for the note. Attached is our completed W-9 (Acme_W9_2026.pdf). Acme Robotics is a US C-Corp; EIN is 12-3456789. I've redacted the SSN line per best practice — the EIN is in section 2 of the W-9. Also attaching a bank letter that includes the company EIN (ACME_Bank_Letter.pdf).

We'd appreciate PO release as soon as possible; we have the integration kickoff slated for next Monday. If you need any additional verification (IRS letter, signed SS-4), let me know and I can request it from our finance team.

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: RE: TIN validation & PO hold — Acme Robotics

Olga / Lauren,

Thanks — I pulled the attached W-9 and bank letter. Quick note on verification: finance policy requires either (a) a copy of the IRS SS-4/CP 575 (EIN confirmation) or (b) a signed W-9 with EIN plus a corroborating public record (e.g., Secretary of State filing that matches the EIN). The W-9 you sent includes an EIN but we need an authoritative corroborating doc to satisfy our auditors.

I ran a basic check against public registries and the EIN returned for a different DBA name; that mismatch prevents us from releasing the PO today. Can Acme supply a scanned SS-4 confirmation or the CP 575 letter from the IRS? Alternatively, if they prefer, we can accept a notarized letter from their bank that explicitly states the EIN and company name (the bank letter you sent doesn't include the registered legal name exactly as on file).

For transparency, keeping PO #4578 on hold until we receive the additional evidence. If Acme can provide the SS-4 or an updated bank letter by Monday, we can accelerate release.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Accountant, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference — Finance
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Hi Aditya / Lauren — thanks for the clear checklist. I requested the SS-4 confirmation from our tax firm and attached the scanned letter they provided (Acme_SS4_Letter.pdf). I also re-attached a corrected W-9 where the company legal name is formatted as it appears on the IRS letter.

For ease of signing I sent the SS-4 letter and updated W-9 via DocuSign as well: https://www.docusign.com/rec/abc123-acme-ss4. Please confirm once you receive the DocuSign envelope.

If anything else is needed, ping me and I'll prioritize.

Best,
Emma
